headline: Daily allowance now resets fully for each simulated stage

changes.title: Give every simulated level its own full daily move bank
changes.detail: The optional player simulator now starts each seed and matched emergency-Hammer trial with a new 24-hour move wallet using that stage's real level-dependent daily allowance. No unused or spent moves carry across attempts.

changes.title: Match real hazard costs and earned move refunds
changes.detail: Automated move spending mirrors the live NutDailyMoves debit and credit rules, including two additional move charges for expired fuses and actual earned elemental move refunds. No purchased or free-claim extra moves are assumed.

changes.title: Verify independent full daily allotments in optional diagnostics
changes.detail: Report-only tests verify level-dependent full allowances, wallet reconciliation, isolated run restarts and explicit methodology documentation without changing gameplay, level goals or booster economy.
